object.name: evi.weightingcoeffs
object.digest: Compute coefficients for A-weighting and other analytical filters and output for <o>cascade~</o>
object.description: <o>evi.weightingcoeffs</o> is simply a lookup table and is therefore extremely efficient. Coefficients are available for a wide range of samplerates and can therefore be used in a downsampled <o>poly~</o> (for example).

inlets.description: (bang) re-outputs the coefficients for the current sampling rate and filter type, (int) sets samplerate manually, meaning the host samplerate can be bypassed and coefficients for a different samplerate can be computed at user time.

outlets.digest: 15 filter coefficents out here, plug into [cascade~] (or 3 [biquad~]s)
15 filter coefficents out here, plug into [cascade~] (or 3 [biquad~]s)
outlets.description: Filter coefficients are designed for a cascade of 3 biquad filters.

messages.name: symbol
messages.digest: In left inlet, set the filter type with the message 'filter', the same as the @weighting attribute
messages.description: Same as the @weighting attribute. The word 'filter' followed by an available filter type sets the filter to use for the coefficients generation. Available types are: A-weighting (or 'A'), B-weighting (or 'B'), C-weighting (or 'C'), K-weighting (or 'K'), ITU-R468 (or 'I'), Dash-weighting (or 'D'), FentonLee1-weighting (or 'F').

attributes.name: hot
attributes.description: @hot 1 will recalculate coefficients the moment a new filter type is selected (and on load). With @hot 0 the calculator is only run when a new samplerate is recieved or via a (bang) to the object.

attributes.name: init
attributes.description: By default, when @init is on (the default), [evi.weightingcoeffs] will produce the selected filter (default A-weighting) at the host samplerate and output these coefficients on abstraction load. If @init is off, nothing is output on load.

attributes.name: samplerate
attributes.description: An integer sets the samplerate to use for coefficients generation. The symbol 'none' uses the host samplerate.

attributes.name: weighting
attributes.digest: Set the filter to calculate coefficients for
attributes.description: Selecting one of the available filter types sets the filter to use for the coefficients generation. Available types are: A-weighting (or 'A'), B-weighting (or 'B'), C-weighting (or 'C'), K-weighting (or 'K'), ITU-R468 (or 'I'), Dash-weighting (or 'D'), FentonLee1-weighting (or 'F').
